podcast.title: Discovered by Carol Burnett
podcast.body: Vicki Lawrence was discovered by Carol Burnett while performing in Los Angeles, leading to her role on "The Carol Burnett Show." "Lawrence is from LA And she was performing in LA When she was discovered by Carol Burnett."

podcast.title: Southern Accent for Character Roles
podcast.body: Although Lawrence is from Los Angeles, she famously adopted a Southern accent for her "Mama" character on "The Carol Burnett Show" and its spin-off, "Mama's Family." "She played up that southern accent for her Mama character on the Carol Burnett show And then the spin off Mama's family."

podcast.title: Star on The Carol Burnett Show
podcast.body: Vicki Lawrence was a star on "The Carol Burnett Show" when her song "The Night the Lights Went Out in Georgia" reached number one. "Now Vicky Lawrence who was a star on the Carol Burnett show When the night the lights went out in Georgia Hit number one."
